notes: vampire.survivors.wiki, vampire-survivors.fandom.com, GameFAQs and steamcommunity.com are all blocked by this session's egress proxy; direct fetches failed. Primary numbers therefore come from a decompiled/extracted copy of the game's own character table (vst-chardata), cross-checked against a community build planner and against a verbatim mirror of the official wiki's Characters/Achievements pages fetched over raw.githubusercontent.com. CONVENTIONS: multiplier stats (might, area, speed, duration, cooldown, luck, growth, greed, curse, moveSpeed) are stored as MULTIPLIERS (1 = unmodified, 1.3 = +30%). maxHealth is flat HP. recovery is flat HP/sec. armor, amount, revival are flat integers. magnet is an additive fractional bonus (0 = unmodified, 0.25 = +25% pickup radius). levelBonuses values are DELTAS applied to the stat at that level (e.g. {stat:'might', value:0.1} = +0.1 to the might multiplier). Source field names map as: power->might, regen->recovery, maxHp->maxHealth, revivals->revival.

conflicts.note: Game data shows base speed 1.1 plus +0.1 at levels 5/10/15 = 1.4 total. Reading the base 1.1 as part of the ability gives '+40% max'; counting only the level-ups gives '+30% max'. Both statements describe the same numbers.
Wiki phrasing is '+20 Max Health' relative to the 100 default; the absolute value is 120. Not a real disagreement, recorded for clarity.

values: price increases +10% additively per character already purchased
conflicts.note: unlockCost is the BASE price. The wiki states every purchasable character's price rises by 10% additively for each character already bought.

unknowns: data.arca.unlockCost (base price cross-check from an official source; 500 taken from vs-build-planner only)

antonio.name: Antonio Belpaese
antonio.unlockCondition: Available from the start (first character a new player uses)
antonio.passiveAbility: Gains 10% more damage (Might) every 10 levels, up to +50% at level 50.

imelda.name: Imelda Belpaese
imelda.unlockCondition: Unlocked by default; must be purchased with gold
imelda.passiveAbility: Gains 10% more experience (Growth) every 5 levels, up to +30% at level 15.

pasqualina.name: Pasqualina Belpaese
pasqualina.unlockCondition: Unlocked by default; must be purchased with gold
pasqualina.passiveAbility: Starts with +10% Projectile Speed; projectiles get 10% faster every 5 levels, for a further +30% by level 15 (1.4x total).

gennaro.name: Gennaro Belpaese
gennaro.unlockCondition: Unlocked by default; must be purchased with gold
gennaro.passiveAbility: Permanent +1 Amount (one extra projectile on all weapons). Also starts with +20 Max Health. No scaling level-up bonus.

arca.name: Arca Ladonna
arca.unlockCondition: Get Fire Wand to Level 4 (achievement 'Arca'), then purchase with gold
arca.passiveAbility: Starts with +10% Might. Weapon cooldown is reduced by 5% every 10 levels, up to -15% at level 30.

porta.name: Porta Ladonna
porta.unlockCondition: Get Lightning Ring to Level 4 (achievement 'Porta'), then purchase with gold
porta.passiveAbility: Permanent +30% Area. Starts at 0.1x Cooldown (a temporary -90% cooldown), which decays back to 1.0x by gaining +0.3 at each of levels 2, 3 and 4.
